## Agenda

- Recap quiz on Session 1
- 2.1  Finding the evidence: PICO to search, Boolean, MeSH, live PubMed demo
- 2.2  Managing and citing: Zotero demo, citation styles, paraphrasing, grey literature
- Break
- 2.3  Reading a paper in 15 minutes - and 2.4 from literature to introduction
- Proposal builder 2: search string, 5 references, problem statement, working title

## Before this session

- Your group's PICO question and your synonym list (Session 1 homework).
- One laptop or phone per group for the PubMed search; Zotero installed if you can.

## After this session (homework)

- **Group:** finish the five key references and the problem statement — Proposal Part 1 complete, with working title and keywords.
- **Each member:** read one paper with the 15-minute routine and fill its row in the literature matrix.
- **Everyone:** read the abstract of [Paper 2](papers.qmd) (Hyun 2023) with the Exercise 3 grid.
- **Optional:** look up Paper 1's registration (NCT04947904) on ClinicalTrials.gov.
